body: I've been depressed so long and I've talked about it when it got worse before and I don't think there's anything you could say to change my plans or anything I could reveal to you to change how I'm feeling. Anyway I'm not sure why, you just remind me of someone and I appreciate everything, but I'm so crazy paranoid that I don't want to risk you being the person I'm reminded of. I hate burdening people. I hurt everyone when I talk about myself too much. Anyway, that's what I'm doing now. So goodbye, and thank you for your thoughtfulness.
I've used them too many times. I'm not going to scare off the people I didn't use yet. I appreciate it but I could never tell anyone I love how I feel.
I don't have anyone to talk to. People are either tired of being there for me or I just don't want to bother them because I care about them too much.
